name: Cloudflare
description: Cloudflare is a global network platform offering application security (WAF, DDoS mitigation, bot management), CDN, and Zero Trust/network services, delivered from a network positioned "50 ms from 95% of Internet users."
best_for: Serves organizations "of all sizes," with free, small-business, and enterprise plans, for blocking DDoS attacks and bad bots, closing vulnerabilities, and accelerating/securing web applications.
features: Single-pass traffic inspection with unified dashboard/API

alternatives.name: Okta
alternatives.description: A workforce and customer identity/access management platform with SSO and adaptive MFA.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises needing centralized identity/access control rather than network-edge security.

alternatives.name: Snyk
alternatives.description: An AI-native application security platform that scans code, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure-as-code for vulnerabilities.
alternatives.best_for: Development and security teams securing the software supply chain and AI-generated code.

alternatives.name: KnowBe4
alternatives.description: A security-awareness and human-risk platform combining personalized training, phishing simulations, behavior coaching, and email-security add-ons.
alternatives.best_for: Security teams whose primary gap is employee behavior and phishing resilience rather than edge, application, or network protection.
